name: explain-why-agent
track: 02 — The Agent That Can Explain Why
description: Asks why a business number changed, investigates across four data sources, tries to disprove its own explanation, and answers with evidence or says it cannot be determined.

entrypoints.docker: docker build -t explain-why-agent . && docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 -e SAMPLE_MODE=true explain-why-agent

sponsors.query_log: logs/queries-<run_id>.jsonl (written per run, adapter and zetaris_sql per query)

sponsors.evidence_note: data/recorded/nemotron/llm_cache/ holds 206 Nemotron replies recorded through Nightshift on 25 Oct for the ten evaluation questions (routed model and receipt per call); replayed with LLM_CACHE_DIR they give the 5/10 score in the README Results. data/sample/llm_cache/ keeps the 15 replies of the live Day 1 run of 23 Oct; the questions default sample mode replays are stub-recorded
